title: Invalid: fragment group initial descriptor gap (no LOSS_TOLERANT)
description: SAR archive where the first fragment descriptor does not start at offset 0 of the logical file and LOSS_TOLERANT is not set. This initial descriptor gap represents missing data and must fail closed.
notes: DEFERRED: requires precise fragment descriptor construction.
Required invariant: initial descriptor gap without LOSS_TOLERANT is always fatal.
OBSOLETE (M13b WP-3): descriptor offsets no longer exist. The canonical equivalent is a missing Fragment Index 0, which is SAR_ERR_FRAGMENT_GAP even under LOSS_TOLERANT. Reassigned to WP-4.
